coverage_note: Hole: Medi's lines 35:37-37:12 are missing; only Amal's prompts survive ('No.', 'No, you said طريق التاني', 'تاني'), so row 1010-21 uses his last line before the hole as t. Fixed his own slip before Amal (GR-22), not scored: 00:46 مع صوت عالي -> بصوت عالي; 07:50 ما بخطط -> 08:02 خططت (her ما خططت came at 08:04); 10:09 واحد -> واحدة; 20:09 حلوة -> حلو; 33:04 hawaii il imi -> أواعي إمي; 39:19 بدي -> بدنا; 52:21 ما تروح -> ما تروحي. 09:57 year ألفين ثلاثة وعشرين vs her chat 'alfain u sitte u 3eshreen' is a wrong fact, flagged only in chat, not a language slip. 06:57 ما خطت: Amal heard مخطط (m5a66et), so this is a meaning mix-up / engine, not scored. 10:29 'بنطلون سودا': her chat puts soda on the blouse and kundara, so the engine may have swapped the noun; left out. 1:00:30 'إشي التاني؟' was a question about the rule, so not a slip. Long English stretches: 03:52-06:16 (app demo), 13:01-13:31, 22:41-24:10, 45:54-47:33, 59:48-1:02:00 (summary in English with Latin-letter Arabic). The 56:40-57:11 يسبط/يبسط letter swap is S4; only the missing b- is filed.

rows.medi_said: أنا رحت، أمم، على مطعم مع صحابي والـ مطعم صوت عالي كتير
rows.right: والمطعم كان صوته عالي كتير (my reading)
rows.why: Past description with no kaan and no link between restaurant and loud sound; Amal only laughed.
mit7ammes takes la- (sheet: 'excited | mit7ammes | متحمس لَ'); she echoed his 'for' twice and he supplied لبكرا.

rows.medi_said: uh, يوم الـ-- يوم الخميس. ... هذا يوم الخميس.
rows.amal_said: الخميس الجاي. ... we would say خميس الجاي cause it's next Thursday.
rows.why: He used هذا يوم الخميس for the coming Thursday; she supplied الجاي and explained it means 'coming'.
The subject 'the first time' (marra) is feminine, so kaan becomes kaanat; she said kanat, then explained 'Because mara is'.
He couldn't produce the word, switched to English 'I met', and she supplied it.

rows.amal_said: What does alta'at take؟ There is two options.
rows.why: She prompted for the verb's fixed preposition and he added مع (sheet: 'balta2i ma3').
He made the same kaan slip 3 minutes after her 12:32 fix and she fixed it again, so it counts as its own slip (GR-32).

rows.medi_said: أكثر من- تنت- آآآ تنتين سنين
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm-mm. How do you say two years؟ ... So how do I say dual for year؟
rows.why: 'Two years' uses the dual سنتين; she prompted until he said it.

rows.amal_said: I tried. You have to point back to it.
rows.why: The object أول أكل is fronted, so the verb needs the pointer ending; she named the rule and he said جربته.

rows.chat: u kaan fi aa5er el-3asha 7ilu falastini
rows.why: She told him the preposition with dinner is 'on' (3ala); he then rephrased to آخر العشاء.

rows.medi_said: احنا عندنا مطعم اسم mata مناقيش.
rows.why: 'A restaurant whose name is' needs the possessive ending on اسم; she let it pass.
rows.english: We have a restaurant called Mata Manakish.

rows.amal_said: كليًا is like completely. ... You would say بشكل عام.
rows.why: He used كليًا (sheet: 'completely / fully | Kulliyyan') to mean 'in general'; she gave بشكل عام (sheet: 'in general / generally | Bishakel 3aam').

rows.medi_said: أكل المفضل، مفضل الأكل. No، أكل المفضل.
rows.why: When the adjective has el-, the noun needs el- too; she repeated الأكل.
kul without el- means 'every'; she said 'Every' and he switched to كل الأكل الفلسطيني for 'all'.
He made the same missing el- slip after her 22:01 fix and she recast it again (GR-32).
He put the adjective before the noun and wavered on its gender; she recast it as noun + feminine adjective, both with el-.

rows.medi_said: No, so هادي كمان الـ كمان أكلة
rows.amal_said: كمان at the end. Don't worry about كمان.
rows.why: كمان before a noun means 'another'; for 'also' she moved it to the end.
rows.english: This is also (my fiancée's favorite) dish.

rows.medi_said: Akli il mufaddal khatibti كمان... هذي
rows.amal_said: How about a cleaner version؟ هذي أكلة خطيبتي المفضلة.
rows.why: He put 'my' on the dish and tacked خطيبتي on after it; she recast it as idafa (aklet 5atibti) and at 31:42 said 'You would have to link خطيبتي'.
rows.english: This is my fiancée's favorite dish too.

rows.why: أكلة is feminine, so the adjective is المفضلة; she recast it.
With هدول and the plural أواعي the adjective is plural; he said المفضلين, then switched to مفضلة after her cut-off 'مفض--', and she gave مفضلين.
rows.english: These are my mom's favorite clothes.

rows.amal_said: الطريق التاني. No, you said طريق التاني.
rows.why: Her 'No, you said طريق التاني' shows he dropped el- on the noun before التاني; he said it right at 37:14.

rows.amal_said: Mm, this is scared. What's scary? ... It scares.
rows.why: خايف means scared; 'scary' is the make-someone form with the doubled middle letter (sheet: 'scary | bey5awwef'). After مخاف and بخاف (she said 'No?') he reached بخوّف.
بخوف is the 'I' form; 'it scares' is بيخوف. She let it pass and it happened again at 55:22 (عيد بخوف), but the engine may have dropped the ي.
كمان meaning 'another' goes before the noun; she said كمان and he moved it.

rows.medi_said: بشرب... Oh, I don't know how to say drink. شرب.
rows.why: He said he didn't know the noun for 'drink' and she supplied عصير.

rows.amal_said: Now you can use wahid or wahida.
rows.why: تاني standing with no noun; she prompted واحد and he said تاني واحد. He may have been cut off before a noun.

rows.amal_said: Ashan it is ahsan. You could say ashano, ashano or ashan huwa ahsan.
rows.why: The clause after عشان needs its subject, here as an ending on عشان; she gave عشانه and he said it.
A plain present verb needs b-; she prompted 'be...' and he got to بيبسط. The s/b letter swap is S4 and is not filed.

rows.amal_said: Yes. So no preposition needed. 'Cause it makes them happy.
rows.why: byebse6 takes its object directly; at 57:28 she had already said no preposition was needed, he added لـ anyway, and she repeated the rule.

rows.medi_said: El walad or walad. No. Yeah, el walad. El walad el zahar.
rows.why: 'Little kids' is plural; she recast the singular ولد as الأولاد.

rows.medi_said: أغلـ أغلب الـ No, it's أغلب إشي
rows.amal_said: Do I put ال؟ ... No, we do. صح.
rows.why: a8lab takes a definite noun; he dropped el-, she said 'we do', and he said aghlab il ishi.

rows.medi_said: اليوم بلبس بلوزة نص كم. white
rows.chat: el-yoam balbes bluze noss kum soda
rows.why: English color word inside an Arabic sentence; sheet: 'white (m/f) | Abyad | أبيض'. Her 'Missكم white' is unclear. Already ruled 'do not correct' (AR-1933).
rows.english: Today I'm wearing a white short-sleeve blouse.
